name: chart-tokens
title: Chart Tokens
author: AlgorizeTech
description: Hook (not a component) that reads the theme's CSS tokens into the plain colour strings Recharts, Chart.js and AG Grid need. Install it when a docs example imports `useChartTokens` from `@/lib/chart-tokens`.
docs: Named exports: useChartTokens, ChartTokens. `useChartTokens(color?)` returns { foreground, muted, border, card, primary, series } and re-reads them when the theme class on <html> changes.
